note: Provision cards are paraphrases written from the repo's gold explanations (benchmark.xlsx, Long Answer), not authoritative statute text. Legal correctness needs a human legal check. Facts: true/false/null (null = not stated in the case).

provisions.card: A claimant is a seasonal worker if the employer is a designated seasonal employer and the claimant performed no services for that employer outside the employer's designated seasonal period. A worker who performs services for the same seasonal employer outside the designated period loses seasonal status, unless the worker regains it: a worker who lost status and is then not employed by that employer between any two following designated seasonal periods is a seasonal worker again. Question asked: is the claimant a seasonal worker (verdict ELIGIBLE means yes, NOT_ELIGIBLE means no).
fields: the employer is a designated seasonal employer
the claimant performed services for that employer outside its designated seasonal period (at any time)
after losing seasonal status, the claimant was not employed by that employer between two following designated seasonal periods

provisions.card: A claimant who quit is entitled to a full award if all three hold: a public health emergency has been declared; the claimant is personally immunocompromised and more susceptible to illness during the emergency; and that status is evidenced by the claimant's own health care provider. General concern, or a family member's condition, does not satisfy it.
fields: a public health emergency was declared at the time of the quit
the claimant's health care provider evidenced the claimant's increased susceptibility

provisions.card: A claimant who quit a construction job to take another construction job gets a full award only if all four hold: the claimant quit within 30 days of the old job's established termination date; the new job started within 30 days of the quit; the new job offered employment for a longer period than remained on the old job; and the claimant later separated from the new job under conditions that would themselves result in a full award (for example a layoff at completion, not a discharge for cause).
fields: the claimant quit within 30 days of the old job's established termination date
the new job started within 30 days of the quit
the new job offered employment for a longer period than remained on the old job
the separation from the new job was under conditions that result in a full award

provisions.card: A claimant discharged for using a controlled substance at work is entitled to a full award if all five hold: the conduct was non-volitional; the separation was directly due to the claimant's substance use disorder; the claimant declared the disorder to the division; the claimant provided medical documentation or proof of the disorder; and the claimant provided proof of participation in an approved treatment program that started within four weeks of the medical statement.
fields: the separation was directly due to the substance use disorder
the claimant declared the disorder to the division
the claimant provided medical documentation or proof of the disorder
an approved treatment program started within four weeks of the medical statement
